text: Closed with exact non-materializing byte arithmetic. Both effect-form and measurement-form preflights now size double matrices from a zero-payload runtime skeleton plus payload arithmetic; named-array state uses zero-payload metadata skeletons. Removed per-feature-block object.size calls from the measurement kernel and derive maxima statically. Focused memory/measurement suite: 131 pass, 0 fail/warn/skip. A 50,000 x 50,000 (20 GB) matrix is sized by regression without allocation.
